backend.scope: Diagnosis only; no repository source edits. Go benchmarks run with -run '^$'; no unit/E2E/build/lint/formatter suites. All benchmark processes exited. Temporary added benchmarks supplied by Go -overlay, not checkout files.

ingest.limitations: 120x40 real ghostty/runtime, max 65536-byte ingest chunks, counting RowStream, no PTY/socket/app. pprof includes benchmark calibration/setup unlike timed metrics.

chunk_probe.feed: Unstyled primary-screen text; synthetic 118 x characters plus CRLF, truncated to each chunk size; no PTY/socket
chunk_probe.limitations: Aggregated pprof across four independently calibrated subbenchmarks. Throughput numbers are not actual native helper CPU or frame rates; chunk phase/content differs slightly due to truncation.

pump.limitations: Real row-bridge/pump encoder; counting sink, no socket; ingest setup outside timer and custom allocation window.

logging_text.limitations: Real Host.request, schema decode, tracing, text logger AddSource and generation, response encode; diagnostic ack service decodes params but does not mutate real session. Output response discarded, one tmp log file sink (native MultiWriter stderr+file not reproduced). Earlier logging.cpu/logging.mem used JSON handler and are not production-format results.

durable_append.limitations: Fresh encrypted content store, real AppendBlockRows through serialized writer; default 256KiB cap crossed during run, six unstyled rows per call. Completed-command fixture supplies execution identity, output artifact remains open. No frontend reads/transport. pprof includes fixture/setup.

backend.limitations: No whole-coordinator/helper process CPU profile acquired. perf executable absent. Component profiles establish expensive mechanisms, not their exact shares of previous native run. No native RAM conclusions. Benchmarks use ordinary host Go compilation, not proof of identical flags/libc to normal helper artifact build.

retainedReplay.note: Actual captured rows, stable artifact identity, 12 evictions and 12 appends per update. Nested timings overlap. Not native CPU or RAM.

nativeAllocation.limitations: Malloc=1, 250x76 grid; peak tracked allocations are not production PSS and trace-end live bytes are not proof of a leak.

nativeCold.conditions: Default allocator; no builtin freeze overrides or allocation profiler. Inspector detached during measurement. 1024x768 viewport; 79-column grids. Six active output producers; an idle seventh tab hides them.
